proposals.before: In the eighth year of Jiaqing he passed the translation-track metropolitan examination, was appointed a director in the Ministry of Rites for the imperial consorts' tombs, was transferred to the Ministry of Works, and was repeatedly promoted to director.
proposals.after: In the eighth year of Jiaqing he passed the translation-track metropolitan examination, was appointed a secretary (zhushi) in the Ministry of Rites for the imperial consorts' tombs, was transferred to the Ministry of Works, and was repeatedly promoted to director.
proposals.reason: 主事 is a secretary/principal post, not 郎中 (director); the literal rendering wrongly uses director for the initial appointment.

decisions.reason: s0058 reads 授妃園寢禮部主事…洊升郎中: the initial appointment is 主事 (zhushi/secretary), distinct from later promotion to 郎中 (director). The prior literal wrongly calls the first post a director; the proposed secretary (zhushi) rendering is accurate and keeps director for 郎中.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 授妃園寢禮部主事，調工部，洊升郎中
